_notes: Universal card-extraction template. Every card (credit, debit, prepaid; any issuer) fills this same shape. Use null for 'not yet verified / unknown', use the string "N/A" for 'this field genuinely does not apply to this card' (e.g. cash_advance on a debit card, invite_only fields on an open-application card), and use [] for 'verified — this card has none of these'. Never delete a key because it doesn't apply — mark it N/A so downstream ingestion can tell 'not applicable' apart from 'not scraped yet'.

card_product.name: CUB CSK/SRH RuPay Platinum Credit Card (lifetime free)
card_product.point_value_baseline_basis: CUB CSK/SRH Rewards Document section 4.1: redemption value RuPay Platinum INR 0.50 per Reward Point (1,000 RP = INR 500) at the rewards portal https://rewards.cub.bank.in/; minimum redemption criteria may apply.

action.reason: No reward points on utilities and telecom, gold and jewellery, rent, wallet loads, insurance, government payments, fuel, cash, gambling and educational services (CSK/SRH Rewards Document section 5).

conditions.merchants: CSK/SRH merchandise and match ticket purchases

action.reason: 3X reward points on CSK/SRH merchandise and match ticket purchases (Rewards Document 2.1); a transaction earns under one structure only.
2 RP per INR 150 on UPI transactions (Rewards Document 2.1).
2X (2 RP per INR 150 instead of 1) on apparel and department stores (Rewards Document 2.1). MCC lists are not stated.
2X on food delivery (Rewards Document 2.1). MCC list not stated.
1 RP per INR 150 on other transactions (Rewards Document 2.1).

category_surcharges.trigger_condition: 1% of each rent payment under MCC 6513 (issuer fee table)
1% on cumulative fuel spends of INR 50,000 or more in a statement cycle (KFS V6)
1% on cumulative utility spends of INR 25,000 or more in a statement cycle (KFS V6, Kavach KFS names MCC 4814, 4899, 4900)
1% on cumulative online skill-gaming spends of INR 10,000 or more in a statement cycle (KFS V6; MCC 5816 per the Kavach KFS)

annual_fee_waiver.evaluation_condition: No annual fee to waive (issuer states nil annual fee).

value.research_method: issuer pages read in a real browser session or issuer PDFs read with pdftotext; no model summaries used as facts

sources.kind: CUB Key Fact Statement for Credit Cards KFS_V6, updated 03.10.2026 (8 pages): fees, interest, forex, fuel waiver, late fee
Card Product Reward Document, CUB CSK/SRH Credit Card (6 pages, issuer folder Apr26): earn rates, redemption value per variant, excluded MCCs
Issuer co-brand page: 302-redirects to the application app (cubcard.cub.bank.in), which showed only a loading screen with no product text

open_questions: Welcome benefit, lounge access, milestone offers and insurance cover for the CSK/SRH cards: none appears in the KFS V6 or the Rewards Document. The issuer page https://cityunionbank.bank.in/co-branded-creditcard redirects to an application app that shows no product text, so no features page was readable. A person should read the CSK and SRH product pages in a browser (or ask the bank) for these.

Team editions: the issuer offers a Chennai Super Kings edition and a Sunrisers Hyderabad edition (per the 7 Nov sweep of the issuer page); the KFS and Rewards Document treat them as one product with the same fees and rewards, so one record covers both.
Annual fee waiver period (card anniversary year or calendar year) is not stated; threshold_spend and period left as stated or null.
Network wording: the variant names in the KFS and Rewards Document carry the network (RUPAY / MASTER); no network tier is stated except World in "Master World".
Reward expiry: the Rewards Document says only "Reward Points may expire as per the Bank's policy" with no period, so point_expiry_months is null.
Cash advance fee is "3% of cash withdrawal amount or INR 250 whichever is higher" at Indian ATMs (KFS V6); atm_transaction_fee_min_inr holds the INR 250 floor. Abroad: 3.5% or INR 1,000.

EMI conversion fee is 2% with a minimum of INR 200 and a maximum of INR 1,000 (KFS V6); only the INR 200 minimum fits the single numeric field, so the percentage and the cap are in this note. Foreclosure 5% of the outstanding amount.
Cheque return / invalid cheque fee INR 300 per return (KFS V6).
Add-on card fee INR 500 + GST one time (KFS V6).
Minimum amount due formula: 5% of purchases and cash withdrawals plus 100% of interest, fees and taxes (KFS V6 illustration).
RuPay UPI: the Rewards Document gives a UPI earn rate for the RuPay card, so is_upi_linkable is true; the document does not say how a RuPay credit card is linked to UPI.
notes: Reward Points are calculated in whole numbers rounded down; reversed or refunded transactions reverse the points (Rewards Document section 6).
Interest 3.5% a month (42% a year) on extended credit and cash advances (KFS V6).
